scenario.name: Inventory service recovery
scenario.scope: One internal inventory service, a PostgreSQL database and twelve authorised warehouse operators.
scenario.drivers: Restore warehouse inventory updates within 30 minutes; data loss must remain below five minutes.
scenario.design: One application instance and a standby database in the existing managed platform.
scenario.cost: EUR 18000 implementation and EUR 6000 annual operation; one-year benefit EUR 32000, with a 25 percent adoption uncertainty.
scenario.risk: Database replication delay can lose updates; lag alert at 60 seconds and hourly recovery-point checks reduce likelihood.
scenario.operations: Warehouse operations owns support from 06:00 to 22:00; the platform duty engineer handles recovery escalation.
